product.name: Sideboards
product.description: Furniture pieces designed for storage and organization in living or dining areas.

product.name: Beds
product.description: Furniture designed to provide a surface for sleeping or resting in bedrooms.

product.name: Chairs
product.description: Seating furniture designed for individual use in various settings such as homes, offices, or public spaces.

product.name: Tables
product.description: Flat-surfaced furniture used for dining, working, or display purposes in various environments.

product.name: Sofas
product.description: Upholstered seating furniture designed to accommodate multiple people for sitting or lounging.

product.name: Washbasins
product.description: Sanitary fixtures designed for washing hands and face, typically installed in bathrooms or washrooms.
